title: AI Agent架构规模化与主权云升级：云计算进入分布式智能与合规新阶段
core_insight: AI Agent架构从概念验证走向企业级规模化部署，同时空间计算和主权云能力突破标志云计算进入智能驱动与合规增强的新范式

dimension_texts.technology: Google Cloud推出多集群GKE Inference Gateway实现AI工作负载全球规模化部署；AWS OpenClaw和火山引擎OpenClaw生态成熟，标志云原生AI代理架构进入企业级应用阶段 Cloudflare Workers AI支持大型模型Kimi K2.5并优化推理堆栈；Azure集成Fireworks AI提供高性能开源模型推理；AWS Elemental Inference实现直播视频AI优化处理 Introducing multi-cluster GKE Inference Gateway: Scale AI workloads around the world Building Distributed AI Agents Introducing OpenClaw on Amazon Lightsail to run your autonomous private AI agents Powering the agents: Workers AI now runs large models, starting with Kimi K2.5 Introducing Fireworks AI on Microsoft Foundry OpenClaw 多 Agent 实战：从零搭建 AI 开发团队 Transform live video for mobile audiences with AWS Elemental Inference Slashing agent token costs by 98% with RFC 9457-compliant error responses BigQuery Studio is more useful than ever, with enhanced Gemini assistant Introducing account regional namespaces for Amazon S3 general purpose buckets
dimension_texts.infrastructure: Cloudflare推出自定义区域功能实现精确地理边界控制；微软主权云扩展支持大型AI模型在完全断开连接环境下安全运行；Blue Origin宣布进入空间数据中心领域标志算力供应向太空扩展 Blue Origin的Project Sunrise计划部署5万颗卫星进行轨道高性能计算；Google Cloud与NVIDIA深化AI基础设施合作优化算力供应；微软主权云新增Azure Local断开连接操作能力 Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin enters the space data center game Introducing Custom Regions for precision data control Microsoft Sovereign Cloud adds governance, productivity, and support for large AI models securely running even when completely disconnected Google Cloud and NVIDIA expand AI innovation across industries at GTC 2026
dimension_texts.application: AI代理在零售忠诚度、医疗金融制造等受监管行业深度渗透；火山引擎OpenClaw集成飞书打造AI员工团队；Salesforce和WordPress.com展示AI代理在内容创作和企业应用的成熟度 Azure推出端到端现代化代理解决方案整合IT工作流；企业AI开发平台成熟降低应用门槛；Forrester TEI研究揭示微软Foundry的企业AI经济学价值 Modernizing regulated industries with cloud and agentic AI Many agents, one team: Scaling modernization on Azure Small Team, Big Game: How We Built Mr. Beast's AI-Powered Puzzle in 27 Days WordPress.com now lets AI agents write and publish posts, and more ArkClaw x 飞书，唤醒你的龙虾助理 Deciphering Customer Signals and Bridging Retail's Loyalty Gap with Agentic AI The economics of enterprise AI: What the Forrester TEI study reveals about Microsoft Foundry Where to Start with AI: A Practical Guide for GTM Teams Unpacking your top questions on agentic AI: The Shift podcast Translating risk insights into actionable protection
